simple.meaning: נְקֵבָה (nᵉqêbâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “female (from the sexual form).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נְקֵבָה (H5347) appears 22 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 1:27, with occurrences in Genesis, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Jeremiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נְקֵבָה (H5347) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in נְקֵבָה (H5347) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: נְקֵבָה (nᵉqêbâh) / H5347 is traced through Genesis 1:27, Genesis 5:2, Genesis 6:19, Genesis 7:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
